summary: Verified Stock:Sale ratio baseline fix + new Dead Items feature end-to-end. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass, all frontend flows (nav, threshold, sort, remove/restore, merged subtext) pass. Baseline seed is idempotent (count stays 358 across backend restart).
critical_code_review_comments: Login form inputs lack data-testid (username-input/password-input/login-button). Minor; placeholder-based selectors work but adding testids would harden regression suites.
server.py appears quite large (ratio logic + dead-items + baseline seed + sales report all in one file); consider splitting into analytics/ submodules per code_review_guidelines on file size.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded preview data + startup-seeded stock_sale_baseline (358 docs).

verification_evidence.ratio_fix: BS-053 avg_stock_kg=313.567 and stock_sale_ratio≈86.0 for 2025 ALL (asserted). 2026 ALL returns non-null ratios. Pre-baseline range (2022-01-01..2022-06-30) returns null ratios without error. No ratio >2000 observed.
verification_evidence.baseline_seed_idempotent: Mongo count = 358 before and 358 after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` + 10s wait. Startup log line: 'Seeded stock_sale_baseline: 358 items as on 2022-12-21'.
verification_evidence.dead_items_endpoint: months_span=~45.6; all items stock_net_kg >= 0.05; ratio == stock/avg within rounding for rows where avg>0.05; TEST_SM gets 403.
verification_evidence.remove_restore: POST /api/dead-items/remove returns 200 (admin), item appears in removed[] with removed_by='admin', not in items[]. Restore moves it back. Unknown item => 404; empty item_name => 400; SM gets 403 on both.
verification_evidence.frontend_dead_items_page: Dashboard shows dead-items-link; /dead-items table has 78 rows, default sort shows 'Never sold' at top (ITEM-ALPHA). Threshold input default='3'; setting to 100 shrinks to 18 rows and badge updates to '18 dead items'. Sort buttons sort-stock_net_kg and sort-stock_sale_ratio toggle without error.
verification_evidence.frontend_remove_restore: Remove button on first row removes row and 'Removed items (1)' link appears; dialog [data-testid=removed-items-dialog] opens; restore-dead-<item> button restores row and link updates to 'Removed items (0)'. Table shows 'incl.' subtext for merged items. Removed list left EMPTY as required.
verification_evidence.sales_report_regression: /sales-report page loads cleanly (260KB HTML). Note: default view is current month Oct 2026 with no data; backend pytest already validated 2025 and 2026 ALL ratios are sane and anchored.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login returns {access_token, ...} — key is 'access_token' not 'token'. Dead-items endpoint is cached 5min inside _report_cache but remove/restore filtering is applied post-cache so changes are immediate. BS-053 anchor avg_stock_kg≈313.567 is the canonical check for the ratio fix.
